title: German football’s fan membership figures continue to climb | Bundesliga
content: The Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 are home to some incredible fan membership figures. The Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 continue to have some of the best supported clubs in the game, with recent figures showing an increase in club memberships in both leagues and Bayern Munich announcing a new world record total. Bayern confirmed at their 2025 annual general meeting at the start of November that they had reached 432,500 members to make them the largest sports club in the world by membership - an achievement president Herbert Hainer said "we can be proud of". It's a huge increase on the 400,000 number they announced to mark the club's 125th anniversary in February, which took them level with Benfica of Portugal, and the total of 382,000 at the previous year's AGM. Dr Hubertus Hess-Grunewald, president and chairman of the supervisory board at Werder, meanwhile, also announced in 2025 when the club reached 64,000 members - of which over 1,000 have been members for life - that "We are incredibly proud of how our membership numbers have grown.

content: # Number of members in each Bundesliga club. Bayern Munich lead the way while RB Leipzig, unsurprisingly, are miles behind the pack. Football in Germany is different. With Germany's 50+1 rule, clubs hold the majority of voting rights which protects the sport from irresponsible private and commercial investors. Challenges to 50+1 persist, as several teams have tried to work around the rule to better compete with other European sides. However, the majority of clubs continue to practice 50+1, believing football is at its best when fans have a voice in their club.
